text:
Lia (PM): Quick thread 1 Q planning: customers keep asking for three console features: route-level cost, lightweight tracing hooks, and error-regression alerts. Need to agree MVP scope + launch gates.

Devin (Eng): Can do metrics-first for cost dashboard (top-10 routes) quickly. Full-span indexing with 30d retention is heavy; suggest phased gated rollout.

Maya (Product): Sales tells me Acme & FinSafe want side-by-side hosted vs dedicated cost view. Make that a checkbox for MVP.

Sanjay (SRE): Define SLOs now: dashboard render p95 <200ms; sampling overhead <15ms p95. Also need KMS metadata + retention toggles for Private/Government customers.

Lia (PM): Proposed MVP: 1) cost-by-route widget (top-10 + hosted/dedicated toggle), 2) trace-hooks-lite (1% default sampling + span attach API), 3) error-regression alerting (route+model-version grouping, basic anomaly detection). Launch gates: Acme demo, perf SLO pass, retention/PII doc.

Devin (Eng): Sampling draft:
```
global_rate: 0.01
priority_routes: [/v1/generate,/v1/embeddings]
max_spans:50
```
Dedicated customers can opt for higher.

Maya (Product): Retention trade: Hosted=14d, Dedicated/Private=30d. UI should surface cost delta when changing retention.

Sanjay (SRE): Note: 14d->30d at 1% sampling ~= +28% storage. Will add to infra cost estimate.

Lia (PM): Actions: Lia: acceptance checklist+Acme runbook (Tue). Devin: perf spike for trace-hooks (Thu). Maya: pricing + customer impact (Wed). Sanjay: SLO test plan + infra delta (Thu).

observability-bot: deploy-bot: canary "trace-hooks-lite" started in staging at 1769991400, job=canary-traces-x, status=running.

Devin (Eng): Early staging: ~6ms p95 overhead at 1% sampling. Will post logs.

Lia (PM): If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock MVP and start tickets. :thumbsup:
